roles.label: Production Workers, All Other
roles.mapping: Official occupation title; available as a current role, not asserted as an emerging role or a growth forecast

roles.label: Teaching Assistants, Preschool, Elementary, Middle, and Secondary School, Except Special Education
roles.occupation_title: Teaching Assistants, Preschool, Elementary, Middle, and Secondary School, Except Special Education

roles.label: Accountants and Auditors
roles.mapping: Official occupation title; available as a current role, not asserted as an emerging role or a growth forecast
roles.requirements_basis: Financial statements, audits, tax returns, financial analysis, spreadsheets and compliance duties support the mapped accounting skills. These are not professional qualification claims.

roles.label: Tellers
roles.mapping: Official occupation title; available as a current role, not asserted as an emerging role or a growth forecast
roles.requirements_basis: Customer transactions, cash balancing, identity checks and transaction records support the mapped banking skills.

roles.label: Team Assemblers
roles.mapping: Official occupation title; available as a current role, not asserted as an emerging role or a growth forecast
roles.requirements_basis: Product quality checks, production reports and training coworkers support quality-management, report-generation and coaching-mentoring. This partial skills map does not imply Lean/Six Sigma certification or machinery competence.

roles.label: Web Developers
roles.mapping: Official occupation title; available as a learner-selected target, not a verified emerging occupation or growth forecast
roles.requirements_basis: Web application development, usability, version control, database access and information security support the selected digital skills.

roles.label: Database Administrators
roles.mapping: Official occupation title; available as a learner-selected target, not a verified emerging occupation or growth forecast
roles.requirements_basis: Database maintenance, query languages, access controls, data standards and cloud technologies support the selected digital skills.

roles.label: Network and Computer Systems Administrators
roles.mapping: Official occupation title; available as a learner-selected target, not a verified emerging occupation or growth forecast
roles.requirements_basis: Network and server maintenance, access controls, security tools, cloud management and Git support the selected digital skills. This partial map does not cover every networking qualification.

roles.label: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
roles.occupation_title: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
roles.mapping: Official occupation title; available as a learner-selected target, not a verified emerging occupation or growth forecast
roles.requirements_basis: Software test plans, automated test tools including Selenium, programming, database tools and version control support the selected digital skills.

roles.label: Business Intelligence Analysts
roles.mapping: Official occupation title; available as a learner-selected target, not a verified emerging occupation or growth forecast
roles.requirements_basis: Querying data repositories, generating reports, dashboard tools, spreadsheets and analysis support the selected digital skills.
